(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan; wherein the studs are spaced a distance of sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced a distance of twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 5: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, and causing the cooled air to flow through an opening.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an outlet. 

(Currently amended) Claim 7: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation and the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover, wherein the front cover is attached to the housing.

(Currently amended) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall and is constructed using structural insulated panels (SIP) or insulating concrete forms (ICF).

(Currently amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; a ventilation grill; and further including instructions. 

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a mounting structure for installation within a structure wall, and an evaporative cooling system configured to cool an indoor area. 

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the mounting structure includes placing the evaporative cooling system between wall studs spaced a distance of sixteen inches on center.
